verdict.rationale: Kimi Code Desktop and CLI document an agent that works on a local project folder: it reads files, edits them, runs commands and verifies results. That amounts to writing and running code against the user's own data and producing files. However, nothing in the evidence describes data analysis, chart generation, or downloadable output inside the assistant chat itself; the Agent-mode help topics are titles only. missing for 10: documented in-chat code execution on uploaded data, chart/visualization output, downloadable file artifacts, hands-on corroboration of data-analysis use

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files

citations.quote: Open a local project folder in Kimi Code Desktop and let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation.
letting it read code, edit files, execute commands, search the web, and autonomously complete development tasks.
